title: ashwingopalsamy/euro-area-deposit-facility-rate-dataset / rates
description: Every change point of the policy rate, with the level before and after, its era and its source.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

central_bank.description: Central bank that sets the rate.

instrument.description: The policy instrument in force on this date.

effective_date.description: Date the new rate took effect (the bank’s local date).

level_kind.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

rate_pct.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

rate_bps.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

rate_low_pct.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

rate_high_pct.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

previous_rate_pct.description: The rate in force before this change, in percent (upper bound for a range). Null for the first point.

change_bps.description: Signed change in basis points against the previous upper bound. Null for the first point and when the instrument or its basis changes (an era boundary), where the two rates are not comparable.

direction.description: `hike`, `cut`, `initial` (first point) or `era_change` (a new instrument or basis).

era_id.description: The period of one rate basis this row belongs to; joins to `eras`.

era_basis.description: `policy` for the policy rate itself, `observation` for an earlier proxy rate kept for history.

evidence.description: `official` when the point comes from the central bank’s own series or statement, `secondary` when from a cited secondary source.

source_id.description: The source of this point; joins to `sources`.

decision_id.description: The announced decision that set this rate, when the decision ledger has it; joins to `decisions`.

release_hash.description: SHA-256 content hash of the release this row was built from.

record_text.description: One deterministic sentence describing the row, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.
